description: Connect your QLASE account to view your courses, classes, materials, assignments, progress, and grades. QLASE recognizes your participation in each course: you can teach one course and study in another. Students can prepare submissions with text, a link, or files. They review an immutable preview and explicitly press its confirmation button in ChatGPT when separately authorized, or confirm in QLASE as an alternative. Work is submitted only when QLASE returns a saved receipt. Teachers can prepare courses, classes, resources, rubrics, grades, feedback, or an individual message; those academic changes still require review and confirmation in QLASE. Access follows account permissions and release gates; you can disconnect at any time. The plugin does not process payments, answer exams, send notices for task submissions, or record learning progress merely because you consult materials.
